note: Mechanical interface of the custom boards (build/15: three boards + the encoder daughterboard that STACK 5.8 requires to be replaceable). Board coordinates: origin at the lower-left corner of the board outline as seen from the component side; mm. place.origin = enclosure coordinates of that corner; place.z_bottom = z of the board face opposite the components; place.facing = direction the component side faces (+z towards the front face, -z towards the rear wall). Only the mechanical interface is defined here; routing, footprints and Gerbers belong to the PCB work (pcb/).

PWR.name: power board (PWR_MAIN + PWR_BRANCH + USB_POWER)

place.mount: plate front face through a 0.5 mm Gelid pad

edge_zones.use: DISP12 to the HDMI board, rails through the plate slot to the rear layer (Micro-Fit 3.0 for >=2 A)

PWR.notes: Fastening: M3 into self-clinching flush nuts in the plate (no cut thread in the plate, STACK 5.8); clinch-nut MPN TBD (MECH-04). The IP2368 retail board sits on the plate in the HMI column (layout item ip2368). Area check: fit-report 'board_area'.

RF.name: RF / detector board (RF_HMC + RF_HF + RF_INJECTOR + DC_CORE)

place.mount: 3.0 mm metal standoffs on the plate rear face; single RF GND/CHASSIS bond at BOND-RF

edge_zones.use: U.FL / MHF to the panel pigtails P1..P8 (build/15: U.FL + coax to panel SMA where the edge is not on the panel)
K401/K402 outputs and Boni bias feed to the HF+ can (row below)
U.FL to the V4L/Lime paths; DC_CORE 8-net boundary connector (13-pcb-preparation)

RF.notes: Single-sided placement faces the rear (towards the module tier on the FR4 lid); 50-ohm GCPW per build/15.

CTRL.name: control / HMI board (CTRL_HMI)

edge_zones.use: harness to the power board and Pico/IMU links (JST PH 2.0)
JST PH to the two ENC daughterboards

CTRL.notes: TL3145BF350QJ switches face the front wall; caps 12 mm, 22 mm pitch (mechanical.json hmi.buttons).

ENC.name: encoder daughterboard (PEC11R-4220F-S0024), same design x2 + 1 spare
ENC.notes: PEC11R rear-facing pins (type 4); bushing M7x0.75 through the 2.6 mm boss with an O-ring (STACK 5.8).
